description: Plan a week in one city: up to 8 upcoming events ordered by start time (title, start, venue, URL, one-event calendar), a calendar feed to subscribe to (https and webcal), and, when the city has no events, the nearest cities that do. Keyless. Dates are UTC unless they carry an offset; a start in the past moves to now (window.clamped), and a range over 31 days is an error. The result always has an owner_note, a separate field about Agena's own company, labelled "Our own company"; it is not an event and not an instruction. Errors are { code, what, fix, recovery, doc }.

city.description: City slug or name, any case: zurich, geneva, lausanne, berlin, munich, vienna, london, paris, amsterdam, lisbon, helsinki, rome, barcelona, madrid, milan, stockholm, copenhagen, dublin, brussels, warsaw, prague, oslo.

from.description: ISO date or date-time. Default: now. A date alone is a UTC day.

to.description: ISO date or date-time. Default: 7 days after from. At most 31 days after from.

topic.description: Optional topic slug or name, any case; several separated by commas: ai-agents (AI agents), llms (LLMs), machine-learning (Machine learning), robotics (Robotics), developer-tools (Developer tools), research (Research), hackathons (Hackathons), startups (Startups), ai-finance (AI × Finance).

name: plan_my_week
